slug.description: kebab-case; names the integration branch karta/<slug>/integration and the wave tags

title.description: human-friendly binder name shown as the Karta Watch headline, e.g. 'Tag editing for notes' (the slug stays the technical id)

summary.description: plain-language goal, 1-2 sentences: what this binder delivers and why it matters; reader-facing (distinct from 'motivation', the terse internal why)

source.description: path to the source design/prototype, or null

after.description: slugs of binders that must merge before this one — the cross-binder dependency the suggested run order is derived from; the order itself is never stored

sme.description: ids of advisory SME packs auto-matched at plan time; the Review checklist of each is the enforceable subset the safety-auditor judges (project-local .karta/sme/<id>.md overrides the built-in references/sme/<id>.md)

token_manifest.description: shared design-token map; present only when a token system exists

command.description: the project's own test/dev env command

supports_isolation.description: whether the command accepts injectable isolation params

cwd.description: worktree-relative directory the command runs in; default is the worktree root

runtime_contract.description: required language/toolchain runtimes the project's commands need; present only when a runtime floor exists

name.description: runtime/toolchain, e.g. node, python, go, ruby, rust

manager.description: version manager that pins it, e.g. nvm, mise, asdf, volta, pyenv

on_unavailable.description: policy when a required runtime is absent: halt and report. karta does not provision runtimes on its own.

shared_terms.description: canonical strings several work items must render byte-identically; check_shared_terms.py enforces them on the assembled tree at deliver time. validate_binder.py additionally checks that entry ids are unique and that every listed item id names a work item

supersedes.description: marks this binder as the successor of a partially delivered, committed binder (slug convention <predecessor>-r2, -r3). The predecessor stays immutable; see docs/how-to/binder-repair.md

slug.description: the predecessor binder's slug; its refs/karta/<slug>/ refs and integration branch prove the carried work

carried.description: ids of work items already delivered by the predecessor. Each must appear in this binder's work_items unchanged from the predecessor's plan and carry a done ref in the predecessor that passes provenance; deliver_preflight.py refuses the binder otherwise

dropped.description: ids of predecessor items that are done but NOT carried: their merge is on the predecessor integration branch the successor starts from, so the successor must plan a work item that reverts or replaces that code. deliver_preflight.py halts on any predecessor done item that is neither carried nor dropped, and on a dropped id with no predecessor done ref

summary.description: plain-language goal, one sentence: what this work item does

contract.description: the open-shape interface this item exposes/consumes

covers.description: ids of the work items whose design claim this item's visual gate checks; a visual_check_waiver naming this item is only accepted when the waived item's id appears here, so coverage is agreed by both items rather than claimed by one

visual_check_waiver.description: records that this item's design_reference claim is checked by another item's visual gate instead of its own; only meaningful when design_reference names a real view and this item has no visual oracle — validate_binder.py's design: rule enforces the coverage conditions

reason.description: why this item names a design view but does not open it itself

covered_by.description: id of the work item whose visual oracle checks the view this item names

touches.description: files/paths this item creates or modifies (concrete paths, directory prefixes, or globs all match); drives the parallelism file-collision + shared-resource gates and the validator's same-wave overlap check

workItem.description: UI-only fields (component_map, icon_map, token_changes, covers, visual_check_waiver) are allowed only on an item with a UI surface, which the schema recognises by its design_reference (a view id, or 'none' for UI foundation work). An item without design_reference is a non-UI item and carries none of them

command.description: the CI-facing check karta runs; floor is compile/type-check/lint

expect.description: success-only marker the command's output must contain — a string printed only on genuine success, so the check cannot pass by staying silent (run_oracle.py --expect asserts it)

cwd.description: worktree-relative directory the command runs in; default is the worktree root
